instructions.a: Add one pack of the same basic type of cutlery as the one I'm using in this saucepan. Any brand, size or material is fine. The pack should contain only that type of cutlery, not a mixed set or a combination multitool.
instructions.b: Also add one pack of the other type of cutlery I'm using in the saucepan now. Keep the first pack.
instructions.bundled: Add one pack matching each of the two basic types of cutlery I use in this saucepan: the one used first and the one used afterwards. Any brand, size or material is fine. Each pack must contain only its own cutlery type, not a mixed set or a combination multitool.
